summary: Round r1 (restricted network; web-search budget exhausted, MoFA/MEA/DHM/ICIMOD document hosts not reachable). Eleven leads recorded: MoFA Nepal and MEA India archives (landing pages), the June 2023 Nepal PM statement (Mahakali-related items), the Indian mission's relations overview, DHM, BIPAD, three ICIMOD documents (2026 Kyirong-Rasuwa flood, transboundary glacial-lake inventory, hydropower basin-risk programme), the ICIMOD site and ThinkHazard. Q1 (treaties on Kosi, Gandak, Mahakali and documented disputes): a five-row inventory is set up (three river instruments, the bilateral water-resources mechanisms, and Nepal-China hydrological data provision), with provisions to extract and dispute topics to verify; no treaty text was retrieved so provisions, dates and disputes are pending, and the platform takes no position on disputes. Q2 (cross-border flood-forecasting data sharing): five arrangement types defined with a three-level test (arrangement exists / data transmitted / data used); all pending. No numbers are recorded.

findings.note: Treaty texts from MoFA Nepal / MEA bilateral documents; amendment instruments; Pancheshwar Development Authority records.

findings.note: Joint-mechanism minutes, official statements, peer-reviewed analyses; report both parties' documents.

findings.claim: Q2: Existence and operating status of Nepal-India flood-forecasting data transmission is pending.
findings.note: Arrangement text; DHM station list and transmission record.

findings.claim: Q2: Existence and operating status of Nepal-China flood-season hydrological data provision, including performance during the 2026 Kyirong-Rasuwa flood, is pending.
findings.note: MoU/implementation plan; ICIMOD event note (17E-L07); DHM warning record. Relevant to S05/S10; escalate to 15/28 if data sharing is shown to have failed.

findings.claim: Transboundary flood/GLOF event losses in Nepal by basin and year.

Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.
Data-sharing arrangements are assessed on three levels (formal arrangement, data transmitted, data used in warnings); a formal arrangement alone does not count as operational early warning.

data_gaps: Kosi, Gandak and Mahakali treaty texts and amendment instruments (document-level URLs not located).
Minutes of Nepal-India water-resources and flood-management committees.
Pancheshwar Development Authority records and DPR status.
Nepal-China hydrological data MoU and implementation records.
DHM list of stations transmitting to India/China and transmission logs.
India-side sources (Central Water Commission, Ministry of Jal Shakti) are not in the source catalog.
SAARC/BIMSTEC disaster-cooperation instruments and activation records.

assumptions.text: Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.
The platform records disputes only as documented by the parties or peer-reviewed sources and takes no position on territorial or treaty-interpretation questions.
Hydrological and disaster data follow the reporting agency's calendar (Nepali dates for BIPAD/DHM, Gregorian for ICIMOD/CWC); dates are converted, not relabelled.

challenges.text: Add catalog ids for India's Central Water Commission and Ministry of Jal Shakti, and for China's Ministry of Water Resources, so 17E can cite both sides of each river arrangement.
X38: please use the three-level test (arrangement / transmission / use) so that the existence of an MoU is not modelled as functioning early warning.
X18: the 2026 Kyirong-Rasuwa event should be recorded as a dated observation from ICIMOD (17E-L07) and BIPAD before being used as a scenario calibration point.

uncertainty: Very high for r1: no treaty text, mechanism minute or data-sharing record was retrieved. The instrument list is provisional (named from domain knowledge) and dispute topics are search targets, not findings. Operating status of data sharing, especially with China, is the largest unknown for S05/S10.
